difficulty_reason: The schemes-side form of the stability of Cohen-Macaulayness under a flat base change of the target. The proof reduces to the local rings and uses that a flat local homomorphism preserves the relevant depth comparison, so that the Cohen-Macaulay property at a point can be read off after the base change. The reduction and the depth transfer make the argument slightly more than a mechanical restatement. Retained author proof at lines 5928-5978.
